---
title: "IPUMS_Ingest"
output: html_document
---

```{r Step 1: Call IPUMS Microdata, include=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# IPUMS CPS ASEC INGESTION
# Wage Premium / Good Jobs Measure
#
# Project: Precariat Politics
# Years: 2000-2024
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ipumsr)
library(here)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Directories
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dir.create(
  here("00_rawdata", "IPUMS_CPS"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  here("01_tidydata", "IPUMS_CPS"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. IPUMS API key
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set_ipums_api_key(
  Sys.getenv("ipums_api_key")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define ASEC samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

years <- 2000:2024

asec_samples <- paste0(
  "cps",
  years,
  "_03s"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_vars <- c(

  # Time
  "YEAR",

  # Demographics
  "AGE",
  "SEX",
  "RACE",
  "HISPAN",
  "MARST",

  # Education
  "EDUC",

  # Employment
  "EMPSTAT",
  "CLASSWKR",

  # Industry and occupation
  "IND",
  "OCC",

  # Geography
  "STATEFIP",
  "REGION",

  # Earnings
  "INCWAGE",

  # Work intensity
  "WKSWORK1",
  "UHRSWORKLY",

  # Survey weight
  "ASECWT"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Create IPUMS extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_definition <- define_extract_micro(
  collection = "cps",

  description = paste(
    "Precariat Politics:",
    "CPS ASEC data for industry wage premium analysis,",
    "2000-2024"
  ),

  samples = asec_samples,

  variables = cps_vars
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Submit extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

submitted_extract <- submit_extract(
  extract_definition
)

submitted_extract$number

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Wait for extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

downloadable_extract <- wait_for_extract(
  submitted_extract
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Download extract
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ddi_path <- download_extract(
  downloadable_extract,
  download_dir = here(
    "00_rawdata",
    "IPUMS_CPS"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Read data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_asec_raw <- read_ipums_micro(
  ddi_path
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Save raw R object
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  cps_asec_raw,
  here(
    "00_rawdata",
    "IPUMS_CPS",
    "cps_asec_2000_2024_raw.rds"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Create analysis dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_wage <- cps_asec_raw %>%
  transmute(
    year = YEAR,
    age = AGE,
    sex = SEX,
    race = RACE,
    hispan = HISPAN,
    marital_status = MARST,
    educ = EDUC,
    empstat = EMPSTAT,
    classwkr = CLASSWKR,
    industry = IND,
    occupation = OCC,
    statefip = STATEFIP,
    region = REGION,
    wage_income = INCWAGE,
    weeks_worked = WKSWORK1,
    usual_hours_last_year = UHRSWORKLY,
    asecwt = ASECWT
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Initial analytic sample
#
# These restrictions are intentionally preliminary.
# We will inspect IPUMS value labels before finalizing them.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_wage_analysis <- cps_wage %>%
  filter(
    age >= 25,
    age <= 64,
    wage_income > 0,
    weeks_worked >= 50,
    usual_hours_last_year >= 35,
    asecwt > 0
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Construct log wage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cps_wage_analysis <- cps_wage_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    log_wage_income = log(wage_income),
    age_squared = age^2
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. Industry-year sample sizes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

industry_counts <- cps_wage_analysis %>%
  count(
    year,
    industry,
    name = "n"
  )

write_csv(
  industry_counts,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "IPUMS_CPS",
    "CPS_Industry_SampleSizes.csv"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. Industry-year descriptive wages
# ------------------------------------------------------------

industry_wages <- cps_wage_analysis %>%
  group_by(
    year,
    industry
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),

    weighted_mean_wage =
      weighted.mean(
        wage_income,
        asecwt,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    weighted_mean_log_wage =
      weighted.mean(
        log_wage_income,
        asecwt,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  industry_wages,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "IPUMS_CPS",
    "CPS_Industry_Wages_Raw.csv"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 16. Save cleaned analysis dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

saveRDS(
  cps_wage_analysis,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "IPUMS_CPS",
    "cps_wage_analysis_2000_2024.rds"
  )
)

write_csv(
  cps_wage_analysis,
  here(
    "01_tidydata",
    "IPUMS_CPS",
    "cps_wage_analysis_2000_2024.csv"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# END
# ------------------------------------------------------------
```


```{r Step 2, Cleaning and Validating CPS Pull, include=TRUE}

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Inspect structure 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
glimpse(cps_wage) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Inspect variable labels and coding 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
ipums_var_info(cps_wage) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Education 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
ddi <- attr(cps_wage, "ipums_ddi") 
# Basic distribution 
summary(cps_wage$educ) 
# Frequency table 
table(cps_wage$educ, useNA = "ifany") 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Employment status 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$empstat) 
table( cps_wage$empstat, useNA = "ifany" ) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Class of worker 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$classwkr) 
table( cps_wage$classwkr, useNA = "ifany" ) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Industry 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$industry) 
# Number of unique industry categories 
n_distinct(cps_wage$industry) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Occupation 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$occupation) 
# Number of unique occupation categories n_distinct(cps_wage$OCC) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Work intensity 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$weeks_worked) 
summary(cps_wage$usual_hours_last_year) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Earnings 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$wage_income) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Weight 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
summary(cps_wage$asecwt) 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Year coverage 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
table(cps_wage$year)
```
